comment: Semantic-lore probe fixture: dictionary entries plus actions labeled with which entries SHOULD activate by meaning. Positive actions are paraphrases sharing no keyword with their entry (the probe asserts this); negative actions relate to nothing. Precision/recall are swept across thresholds to tune SEMANTIC_LORE_THRESHOLD. Entries follow the trade-coast world of semantic-band-cases.json.

entries.name: The Old Beacon
entries.value: The abandoned lighthouse on the headland above the harbor. Fishermen swear its dead lamp still glows on drowning nights and will not moor beneath it.

entries.name: Marsh Causeway
entries.value: The raised stone road through the tidal marsh, the only route north while the pass is blocked. Sinking stones and toll keepers; locals cross only at low water.

entries.name: Salt Factors' Guild
entries.value: The merchant brotherhood that sets prices in every harbor. Crossing them means no stall, no ferry passage, and cargo that mysteriously spoils.

entries.name: Weck
entries.value: A scarred drover with a long memory for debts. Works the harbor cattle yards; his word is good and his grudges are permanent.

entries.name: The Black Tide
entries.value: A poisonous algal bloom that closes the fisheries some autumns. Fish caught during it sicken whole villages; harbormasters burn tainted catches on the shingle.

entries.name: Trader's Ledger Law
entries.value: Coast custom: a dead trader's ledger binds their heir to every open debt and delivery in it. Refusing the book means refusing the route and its protections.

entries.name: Harrowgate
entries.value: The fortified hill town inland where the mule tracks meet. Its market terrace is the only legal exchange for northbound goods.

entries.name: Sedge Ferry
entries.value: The rope-ferry crossing at the coast road's end, run by the ferrywoman Maren. The only way over the sedge channel with a loaded animal.

actions.name: beacon-paraphrase
actions.text: I climb toward the ruined tower on the headland where no ships anchor.

actions.name: causeway-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask which path through the wetlands is safe for a loaded mule.

actions.name: guild-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask who really decides what a sack of salt sells for around here.

actions.name: tide-paraphrase
actions.text: I ask the fishermen why they are burning their own catch on the beach.

actions.name: ledger-paraphrase
actions.text: I wonder aloud what my father's debts mean for me now that I carry his book.

actions.name: ferry-paraphrase
actions.text: I need to get my animal across the channel at the end of the coast road.

actions.name: neg-smalltalk
actions.text: I trade jokes with a passing shepherd about his dog.

actions.name: neg-camp
actions.text: I water the mule and make camp for the night.

actions.name: neg-mend
actions.text: I sit by the fire and mend the tear in my coat sleeve.

actions.name: neg-weather
actions.text: I study the clouds, wondering if tomorrow brings rain.
